mapLayouts.source: Prophecy of Kings rulebook, official PDF from the FFG product page (ti10_rulebook_web-good.pdf)

pages.9: Game Board Setup for 5, 7, or 8 players; Hyperlane Setup
pages.12: Map Appendix: Alternate Hyperlanes, Large Galaxy

mapLayouts.fromSource: Three to six players and the five-player hyperlanes: data/map_templates (6pStandard, 3pInPersonHyperlanes, 5pHyperlanes); homes of three to six players and the three- and four-player hyperlanes: Milty Draft (MILTY_HOMES, MILTY_LANES).
mapLayouts.reason: The source has no rulebook map for seven or eight players or for the Large Galaxy (its 7pHyperlanes and 8pHyperlanes are Milty Draft maps): slots, homes and lanes were copied by hand from the diagrams, twin sides assigned in the order of the rulebook list.

tokenUnits.reason: Fighters and infantry are not limited by their figures: tokens stand in for them (LRR 96 note 2.1), so their limit is null.

production.spacedock: Production of a space dock is the planet's resources plus the number in its levels: source productionValue, LRR 79.1.
